title: Ather
tagline: Flutter client on Codeberg — a product-shaped mobile app kept outside GitHub.
overview: Ather is a Dart/Flutter app published on Codeberg. It sits with Safar and Mahdi as product clients I keep in the public Codeberg account.
problem: Needed a public home for a Flutter product client that was not going on GitHub.
solution: Ship the Flutter app on Codeberg under ammarshamea123 and treat it as a first-class portfolio entry.
architecture: Flutter/Dart mobile client. Source of truth is the Codeberg repository.
challenges: Keeping Codeberg and GitHub stories aligned without duplicating every repo
lessonsLearned: A second forge is useful if you actually publish finished clients there
futureImprovements: README with screenshots in the Codeberg repo
results: Public Flutter product client available at codeberg.org/ammarshamea123/ather_app
